camel_example: aliyun rds CreateParameterGroup --region cn-hangzhou --EngineVersion '5.7' --Parameters 'back_log_:_3000_,_wait_timeout_:_86400' --ParameterGroupName test1234 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Engine mysql
description_en: Creates a parameter template for an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于创建RDS参数模板
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-parameter-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --parameter-group-name test1234 --engine mysql --engine-version 5.7 --parameters back_log_:_3000_,_wait_timeout_:_86400 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateParameterGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the parameter template. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent zone list
parameters.help_zh: 创建参数模板的地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the parameter template.

The value must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), and underscores (_).
The value can be 8 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
模板的名称。
以英文字母开头，由英文字母、数字、小数点（.）或下划线（_）组成。
长度为8~64个字符
parameters.name: parameter_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

mysql
PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：
mysql
PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version of the instance.

If the instance runs MySQL, the instance must run one of the following MySQL versions:

    *   5.6
    *   5.7
    *   8.0

If the instance runs PostgreSQL, the instance must run one of the following PostgreSQL versions:

    *   10.0
    *   11.0
    *   12.0
    *   13.0
    *   14.0
    *   15.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: A JSON string that consists of parameters and their values in the parameter template. Format: {"Parameter 1":"Value of Parameter 1","Parameter 2":"Value of Parameter 2"...}. For more information about the parameters that can be modified, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96063.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96751.html
parameters.help_zh: 参数和值的JSON串，格式：{"参数1":"参数1值","参数2":"参数2值"......}。可修改的参数请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96063.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96751.html
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The description of the parameter template. The value can be up to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 参数模板的描述。长度为0~200个字符
parameters.name: parameter_group_desc

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to obtain the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ParameterGroupId.description_en: The ID of the parameter template. You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144491.html） operation to query the IDs of parameter templates
ParameterGroupId.description_zh: 参数模板ID。可以通过接口[DescribeParameterGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144491.html）查看参数模板ID
